Chief_Complaint.content: Patient presents with sore and cracked skin on her hands for the last 3-4 months.
Chief_Complaint.source_text: I have uh soreness in my fingers, my finger, like, the skin on my hands is kind of cracked... I got it three, four months ago.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: The symptoms are mainly on the palms of the hands and have become painful enough to interfere with her job.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Uh the palm... it's gotten to a point where, where it hurts a lot. And I can't really do my job.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: The skin is occasionally itchy and has bled sometimes when scratched.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Yeah, it's itchy. Not all the time, but yeah, it does get itchy... when I scratched it, yes it has bled sometimes but, yeah.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient works as a housekeeper in a hotel and does not always wear gloves, which is a possible trigger.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: I do work as a housekeeper... I'm not always very good about wearing gloves... At a hotel.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: The symptoms started around the same time she switched jobs four months ago.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: I switched jobs, uh four months ago.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient has tried E45 cream and antihistamines with no relief.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: I tried uh E forty five... no it didn't really do anything... I also tried an antihistamine, antihistamine. Uh but it didn't

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient denies any associated fever, nausea, vomiting, or changes in bowel or urinary habits.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: have you had any other symptoms, such as fever, or temperatures? No... Any nausea, or any vomiting? No... Any problem with your bowels? No.

Past_Medical_History.content: Patient has no prior history of skin problems like eczema or dermatitis.
Past_Medical_History.source_text: Eczema, dermatitis, for exmaple? Not that I know of. No, I haven't been diagnosed.

Medications.source_text: Which medications do you take? Metformin

Adverse_Drug_Reactions_and_Allergies.source_text: Do you have any allergies...? No.

Family_History.content: Patient has a family history of diabetes.
Family_History.source_text: Family history-wise, is there anything I should be aware of? Diabetes and what? Diabetes as well. Yeah.

Social_and_Family_History.source_text: Laura Parkinson. And uh I'm forty five.
Do you smoke at all? No.

Social_and_Family_History.content: Patient drinks minimal alcohol (a couple of pints a week).
Social_and_Family_History.source_text: Do you drink much in the way of alcohol? a couple of pints a week.

Social_and_Family_History.content: Patient has had to take the last three days off work due to her symptoms.
Social_and_Family_History.source_text: like the past three days, I haven't been able to go to work.

Assessment.content: The impression is contact dermatitis, likely related to cleaning products at work.
Assessment.source_text: I think you might have something called dermatitis or contact dermatitis... very common in, particularly people in your in your in your field, who are using cleaning products

Plan_of_Care.content: Advised to avoid triggers by wearing gloves at all times when cleaning.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: I strongly recommend that you wear gloves when cleaning at all times.

Plan_of_Care.content: Prescribed a steroid cream to help with inflammation.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: we can try some steroid creams to help with the inflammation.

Plan_of_Care.content: Prescribed stronger emollients to be applied 3-4 times a day for moisturizing.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: As well as some stronger emollients, um which you really need to kind of coat on, three four times a day

Follow_up_Information.content: Patient to return for review in 10-14 days if symptoms have not improved.
Follow_up_Information.source_text: if it still hasn't got better in about a week, two weeks time, I really need you to come back and see me again... minimum couple of weeks. Uh ten days to fourteen days.

Follow_up_Information.content: Advised to return sooner if symptoms worsen (e.g., spreading or increased dryness).
Follow_up_Information.source_text: if it's getting worse, like if it's spreading, or dryness is getting worse, come back and see me sooner.
